Omdb._comment: OMDb API key comes from the Render env var Omdb__ApiKey (double underscore → maps to Omdb:ApiKey). Keep this blank — never commit a key here.

CineMind._comment: Seeds the deterministic daily puzzle generator. Set the Render env var CineMind__PuzzleSalt (double underscore). Keep blank here — with no salt the daily puzzle is still deterministic but becomes guessable in advance, so this must be set in production.

Apify._comment: Nightly CinemaClock showtime scrape. Both come from Render env vars Apify__ApiToken and Apify__WebhookSecret (double underscore → maps to Apify:ApiToken / Apify:WebhookSecret). Keep these blank — never commit them here. WebhookSecret must match the x-apify-secret header configured on the Apify webhook.
